content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Utkal University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://www.utkaluniversity.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Utkal University Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the offline application for the Utkal University Guest Faculty (Assistant Professor) posts is 21st August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: There are a total of 14 vacancies announced for the Guest Faculty (Assistant Professor) positions across various departments at Utkal University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualification required is a Ph.D. Degree for PG courses, or candidates without a Ph.D. qualification can apply for PG/UG courses, as per UGC Guidelines, 2018.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary structure for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: For Ph.D. holders, the salary is Rs. 1000/- per class (max Rs. 60,000/- per month), and for others, it is Rs. 750/- per class (max Rs. 45,000/- per month).

faq.question: Q5. Is there any age limit for retired faculty applying for these posts?
faq.answer: Yes, retired faculties can continue to serve until 70 years of age, provided their performance is satisfactory and subject to periodical review.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for Utkal University Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via Speed Post/Registered Post.

faq.question: Q7. Which departments have vacancies for Assistant Professors?
faq.answer: Vacancies are available in departments such as AIHCA, Botany, Commerce, University Law College, LLM, Library & Information Science, Psychology, and Zoology.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Utkal University: https://www.utkaluniversity.ac.in.

faq.question: Q9. What documents need to be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents like photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant certificates.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for these Guest Faculty positions.
